messages.content: We are building a local conversation memory and recovery system. It must run without external chatbot APIs.
One option is to send every conversation to a hosted LLM for summarization.
Do not use hosted APIs. Keep all conversation data local, and use SQLite for persistent storage.
Understood. We will use SQLite and local processing.
Please preserve disagreements and uncertain claims separately from confirmed decisions. Source references are required.
The original research pipeline has turn-level importance classifiers, but those models do not extract structured facts by themselves.
Agreed. Keep importance ranking separate from fact extraction. Next, validate recovery using the stored memory only.
We still need to decide which optional local language model, if any, improves extraction quality.
